FIGURE = DESCRIPTOR-ONLY (grounding R2): E2-figure ships as a persistent descriptor {present-w0, fossil-w0, flattening f≈(5/4)ω²a³/GM} computed FROM drivers — D8 rotationHours newly plumbed into body-condition-vector.js (it has NO rotation field today), a-term = body radius (NEVER shellThickness, §7b delegable-#4 trap), GM from surfaceGravity+radius. NO visible oblateness render this increment (the fixed-sphere pipeline cannot express body shape; building that path collides with the atmo branch's shader territory). V2-7 CYCLE-2 needs only the descriptor. shellRelief's random w0 axis ('shell:axis:') is a RED HERRING — sibling-local, not driver-originated; it stays untouched.

PROVINCE = CARRIER FIELD + LAB DEBUG OVERLAY (grounding R3): the history-tied E12-province ships as a byte-inert carrier field derived from faultDensity/grainMag/accommodation (cratons/orogens/basins) + a false-color lab debug overlay so Max can inspect it. The existing position-noise shader gProvince (which IS the bag-of-overlays) is NOT rewired here — that is V2-9's job (palette derives from province there). The honesty bar is AC-PROVINCE-ASSOC: a shuffled-seed/independent-noise province must FAIL the association test.

STRESS-FABRIC = V2-7d-MOLD EXTRACTION: steeredNoise3 exists as 4 verbatim module-private copies (tectonic.js:93 canonical; shellRelief/mixedInterior/stagnantLid copies). Extract into one owned module, byte-identical at all four call sites (dual-run equality, the lidDisruption.js precedent: family module, disjoint namespace, own validation suite, zero production behavior change).

HOST CHANNELS ARE NEW, NOT REPURPOSED: sediment + accommodation are two new Float32Array channels on makeSphereField AND makeSubstrate (parity) — explicitly NOT the E9-owned maturity/baseLevel (allocated-but-unwritten on the sphere path, reserved). accommodation is bounded [0,1] SINK-RANKING only — no mass-conservation claim (V2-7 owns the volumetric budget).
